syllabus_topics: Concrete Structures - Calculation of basic structural elements
Soils in Construction - Composition of Soils
Soils in Construction - General Properties of Soils
Soils in Construction - Soil Recognition and Characterization
Soils in Construction - Vertical Stresses in Soils. Terzaghi's Law.
Soils in Construction - Shear Strength Resistance
Practice 1 – Study of dosing, manufacturing and tests for consistency and strength of concrete specimens
Practice 2 – Calculation of concrete structures using commercial software
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a global average grade equal to or greater than 5/10 must be achieved, and a grade equal to or greater than 3/10 must have been obtained in the exams for each part of the course. The first and second partial exams are voluntary and liberating. The final exam includes topics 2, 3, and 4 for all students, and students may retake previously failed partials or must take parts they missed. In the extraordinary resit, students can retake exams for failed or improved parts, but practices cannot be redone. The best grade will be chosen between the ordinary grade (including practices) and a grade solely from the theoretical exams (100% weighted average of theoretical parts).
